bull_case: $90B+ 현금·유가증권과 연환산 기준 강한 영업현금흐름이 대규모 AI 투자를 자체적으로 상당 부분 흡수한다. 장기 고정금리 채권 만기가 분산돼 있어 신용경색에서도 핵심 사업과 AI 투자를 계속할 수 있다.
bear_case: 2026년 들어 현금창출보다 인프라 의무가 훨씬 빠르게 커졌다. 미개시 리스와 비취소 약정이 수천억 달러이며, 2026~27년 현금지출 집중과 법률 비용이 겹치면 순현금 쿠션이 빠르게 줄고 추가 차입 의존도가 높아질 수 있다.
thesis: Meta의 단기 생존위험은 낮다. 6월말 현금·유가증권 $90.26B, Notes $84B, H1 OCF $64.09B로 영업 자체가 자금을 만든다. 반면 비취소 계약 $349.31B와 미개시 리스 $278.99B(+7월 추가 $68B)는 향후 현금흐름 변동성을 크게 높인다. H1 희석주식수는 전년보다 감소했지만 약정/TTM 매출 비율이 약 1.53배여서 dilution_offbalance 관측표의 낮은 축 55점이 구속한다.

evidence.claim: At June 30, 2026 cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities were $90.26B; aggregate principal of notes was $84.0B, with maturities from 2027 through 2066.
H1 2026 operating cash flow was $64.09B; FY2025 OCF was $115.8B, demonstrating that the operating business remains strongly internally funded despite rising capex.

Meta disclosed $349.31B of non-cancelable contractual commitments at June 30, 2026, with $53.52B and $81.65B due in 2026 and 2027; uncommenced lease obligations were $278.99B and July added about $68B of data-center leases.
H1 diluted weighted-average shares were 2.565B versus 2.580B in H1 2025, even though H1 share-based compensation expense was $13.626B; there were no share repurchases in H1 2026.

The August 2026 bipartisan attorneys-general agreement contemplates about $18B of payments over ten years and an expected ~$10B Q3 2026 legal expense accrual; July operating guidance was otherwise unchanged.

counterevidence: H1 2026 free cash flow was compressed by extraordinary AI capex, including just $0.784B in Q2.
미개시 리스와 비취소 계약이 현재 유동자산보다 훨씬 커 장기 재무 유연성은 과거보다 낮다.
2026년 5월 $24.91B 순채권 발행으로 현금쿠션을 보강해 외부조달 사용이 이미 증가했다.
RSU 미인식 보상비용과 예약 주식 수는 크므로 주가가 하락할 경우 경제적 SBC 부담이 커질 수 있다.
unknowns: $349.31B 계약 중 실제 현금지출 시점·취소 가능성·상대방별 재협상 가능성의 세부 내역은 공시가 제한적이다.
falsifiers: TTM OCF가 $84B 총차입 아래로 하락한 상태가 지속된다.
2027년 약정 지출을 위해 반복적 대규모 채권·주식 발행이 필요해진다.
희석주식수 CAGR이 3년 연속 8% 이상으로 상승하면서 owner FCF/share가 정체된다.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: Operating activities generate substantial cash; H1 2026 OCF was $64.09B. Debt issuance supports discretionary acceleration of infrastructure rather than a business that cannot fund operations without repeated external capital.
The veto's required elements are not met: H1 diluted weighted-average shares declined YoY, so long-duration excessive net dilution and per-share-value destruction are not established.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Cash and marketable securities roughly match notes, operating cash generation is very strong, and Bear valuation still assumes meaningful owner FCF rather than business-value extinction.

next_checks: Update commitments and uncommenced lease obligations after Q3 filing.
Recalculate TTM OCF/debt and capex/OCF after Q3 2026.
Track net share count against rising SBC and the absence/resumption of buybacks.

subscores.rationale: The 75 'strong liquidity' anchor fits $90.26B liquid securities against ~$84B notes plus strong OCF. The 90 'net cash/very strong' anchor is excluded because the net-cash cushion is small relative to rapidly rising infrastructure commitments.

The 75 anchor fits a business able to fund itself from internal cash generation through stress. The 90 anchor is excluded because 2026-27 infrastructure commitments are large enough that continued investment may still use external debt markets.

Share dilution is favorable (H1 diluted shares -0.6% YoY), but the two-axis observable uses the lower score. TTM revenue is about $228.25B (FY2025 $200.97B + H1 2026 $117.11B - H1 2025 $89.83B); $349.31B non-cancelable commitments are ~1.53x TTM revenue, placing the off-balance axis in the 1~2x row = 55.

uncertainties.rationale: Long-dated infrastructure obligations have increased far faster than historical balance-sheet debt.
The contractual-commitment ratio is high even though accounting share dilution is currently contained.

dilution_metrics.rationale: H1 diluted weighted-average shares fell from 2.580B to 2.565B YoY. SBC is high, but net dilution is not currently persistent or excessive.
